scope: bounded current-facing presentation and character/preset consumer scan

findings.detail: Current character-facing audit and Characters.md resolve to the live canonical count of 152; older 153 statements remain dated historical context.
51 preset records resolve to explicit character IDs; no unresolved preset character IDs or orphan reverse character targets were found in the existing character presentation audit.
Chapter 4 presentation audit is registered and its publisher-backed system counts remain separated from unresolved item-level research.
The source-observed Goku in-game-data table exposes named loadout rows, but repository numeric Goku preset IDs cannot safely be mapped by row order. No Goku loadout was promoted.

evidence_boundary: This bounded scan does not establish complete event history, complete preset numbering, complete loadouts, acquisition conditions, rotation, drop rates, or historical chronology.
next: Resolve additional exact numeric preset mappings only where a source directly binds the source row to the repository preset ID; otherwise continue the highest-impact thin-domain research without inference.
